note: The narrator's lines (GAME-V3.md section 6). trigger names the moment (see src/narrator/logic.js); lines that share a trigger play in order, or one is picked by the wave number when the trigger has variants. priority 1 is generated first when voice credits are short. Each line's voice file is public/audio/voice/narrator-<id>.mp3, listed in manifest.json. A missing file keeps the caption.

lines.text: The lighthouse of the Saltreach Isles has gone dark. And out on the black water, Captain Redtide's pirate fleet has noticed.
This island is yours to hold, captains. Build a wall and a cannon on the empty spots, then ring the bell, and the first pirates will come.
Welcome back, captains. Your island waited for you, and every wall is still standing. Ring the bell when you are ready.
Back again, and not a moment too soon. Redtide's sails are gathering on the horizon. Check your towers, then ring the bell.
Here they come! Your cannons fire on their own. When the wave is over, spend your loot on more walls and cannons.
Each wave comes when you call it, with the bell or with Next wave in the break. Every one is stronger, so build first, then call them.
Don't just watch from the beach, captain. Click or tap toward a ship, or press F, and your own musket fires.
Some of these ships carry boarders. Walls stop them at the shore, so keep a wall on every path to the heart of the island.
A warship leads this wave, one of Redtide's own. It takes many hits to sink, so keep every cannon on it, and don't let it reach the shore.
Your first wave is won! Captains can grow stronger now. Open the Menu, then Captain, and spend your coins on a better musket.
Settlers have come to your shores. Build them a house, and every wave you win will bring in a little more loot.
Your towers can grow now. Walk up to a wall or a cannon you built and raise it to level two: thicker stone, heavier shot.
The mortar is ready. It throws its shells high over the water and hits every ship near where they land, but never ships close in.
Build a watchtower. From up high, its lookouts help every tower nearby fire farther out to sea.
A gunner wants to join your crew. Hire one in the Menu, under Crew, and your strongest tower will reload faster.
The market stall at the Harbor is open. Guess whether a real price goes up or down in five minutes, and put a few coins on it.
You sank the warship! Now raise the inner ring of walls around the heart. If boarders get past the shore, it is your last line.
A carpenter has signed on. She mends your most damaged wall while the battle rages. Hire her in the Menu, under Crew.
A wreck has washed onto the beach. Mend her hull a little after every wave, and one day she may carry you out to sea.
The match board is up at the Harbor. Pick who wins a real football match, and a good pick pays out in coins.
The Tech hub has opened its doors. Research a skill there once, and every tower of that kind on the island learns it.
The wreck sails again! Between waves, your crew can take her out to sea and fight pirate ships for extra loot.
Twelve waves held! Cannons and walls can go up to level four now, the watchtower to level three. Watch out: Redtide sends fast red-sailed raiders.
Redtide is angry, and his warships come tougher now. Raise your mortars and your watchtower to level four to meet them.
Twenty waves! Every tower and wall can reach level five, the highest of all. And Redtide's brutes come ashore: big pirates who hack through walls.
Thirty waves. Redtide's iron ships join the fleet, and his ships grow tougher with every wave. Research at the Tech hub and fight as one crew.
Redtide sends his dreadnoughts now. No tower holds them alone. Bring the whole crew, every tower at level five, and every skill you have.
A house with a job! A Barracks sends out militia, a Tavern patches up tired captains, and a Workshop keeps the walls standing.
Boarders on the beach! They are running for the heart of the island. Fight them up close, or let your walls hold them back.
A captain has fallen! Stand next to them and hold E to help them back up.
One of the crew is down. Reach them quickly, and hold E to bring them back.
Back on your feet, captain. The fight is not over yet.
Well done. No captain gets left behind on this island.
Every captain has fallen. With no one left to defend it, the island cannot hold this wave.
The heart of the island is in danger! Drive the boarders back, now!
The heart is failing! Every captain, back to the middle of the island!
The pirates broke through this time. Take a breath, mend your walls, and ring the bell again.
A hard night. Redtide's crew sails off laughing, but the island is still yours. Build stronger and call them back.
Lost, but not beaten. Every captain learns from a wave like that one. Patch the walls and ring the bell.
Another wave beaten! Count your loot, and build before the next one.
The sea is quiet, for now. Spend your coins well, captains.
Well fought! Redtide lost more ships today than he can count.
The island holds. Somewhere out there, Redtide is shouting at his crew.
Wave ten. This is a real fight now. Every captain to their post, and keep your walls mended.
Wave twenty. Redtide has stopped laughing. His fleet is bigger than ever, and so is your island.
Wave thirty. Use what you learned at the Tech hub. Skill, not luck, wins from here.
Wave forty. The other isles are watching your shore. If you hold here, the whole coast can hold.
Wave fifty. Stand together, captains. This one needs the whole crew.
Wave sixty. The wind is turning your way. Keep the cannons hot.
Wave seventy. Redtide is throwing everything he has left at you. Hold steady.
Wave eighty. Old sailors at the Harbor already sing songs about this island.
Wave ninety. Ten more, and the lighthouse burns again. Don't stop now.
Twenty-five waves held! At the Harbor, they are starting to say your island cannot be taken.
Fifty waves! Half of Redtide's fleet lies on the sea floor. The other half is coming for you.
Seventy-five waves. Up on the hill, the lighthouse glass catches a faint glow. You are close.
This is it. Redtide himself sails at the head of the whole fleet. Hold the island one last time, and the light will burn again.
The flagship sinks, and the fleet scatters into the night. Captain Redtide is beaten.
On the hill, the great lamp flickers, then blazes. The light of the Saltreach Isles burns again. Well fought, captains.
